ac.ability.vecmanip.autonomous_vector_ci: NEW452 provisional kinetic-defense prototype. Tap to toggle; release is free, and a fresh tap turns it off. Uses the shared base + lower + upper reserve, capped at 2S, against supported hostile native kinetic contacts from within 8 m and the forward 160-degree 3D sector. The rear is open. At most 8 positive absorptions per rolling 20 server ticks and 4 in one tick; CP, mastery and rapid toggling cannot bypass these physical limits. Unknown damage sources and unsupported attacks keep native behavior. This prototype does not reflect projectiles. Gray-white open flow shows the received sector and eight physical quota marks; a brief local compression appears only after confirmed positive absorption. LV5 after learned Multi-Axis Reflection, with no mastery gate. All tuning is provisional.
